title: Set Room Light
description: Control the room ceiling light via IR (Arduino-IRremote compatible). Uses IrSender.sendNEC(address, command, repeats) encoding: LSB-first NEC, address=0xD001, commands all=0x20 eco=0x21 night=0x22 off=0x23. Hardware: Orange Pi PC11 (DATA, board pin 12) + 5V + GND; DATA idles LOW. Prefer mode=off/all/eco/night.

mode.description: Ceiling light mode → sendNEC(0xD001, cmd): all=0x20, eco=0x21, night=0x22, off=0x23. Preferred over power_on.

brightness.description: -1 keeps current brightness; otherwise 0-255 (stored only; IR remote has no brightness channel).

color_temp_k.description: 0 keeps current color temperature (not used by this IR remote).

color_rgb.description: Optional #RRGGBB (not used by this IR remote).

ir_code.description: Optional override as 0xD001:0x23 (same as Arduino addr/cmd). Normally derived from mode.

repeat.description: Extra NEC frames after the first (Arduino IrSender.sendNEC third arg). Default 3.
